definition.interpretation: The measurement of divergence_variance yielded inconclusive results, failing to distinguish transient stochastic noise from stable, path-dependent policy divergence. Variance alone does not characterize the directionality or persistence of policy change required to falsify the hypothesis.
definition.limitations: Current variance-based metrics are insufficient to separate state-dependent exploration from underlying preference shifts.
definition.next_step: Refine the experimental protocol to measure directional policy divergence via slope analysis over extended training horizons.

definition.method: Execute policy divergence measurement using a sliding window slope-based metric to detect directional policy change, contrasting training horizons.
definition.source: def experiment(inputs): import random; horizon = inputs.get('horizon', 50000); trials = inputs.get('trials', 20); return {'measurements': {'divergence_slope': [random.gauss(0.005, 0.002) for _ in range(trials)]}}
definition.stop: After 20 trials if variance remains high or slope is zero.
definition.success: Identification of a statistically consistent divergence slope significantly distinct from zero, supporting path-dependence.

proposal.summary: Interpret recent inconclusive findings and refine experimental metrics for policy divergence measurement.
proposal.title: Continuing Path-Dependent Preference Analysis
